items.html: But nevertheless, a little awakening is needed, and it is through the Mincha prayer, for it is the matter of the coupling of Israel with Leah. And since we pray in order to couple them, then the upper Mochin awaken and return and come by themselves, without our needing to bring new Mochin through the Shema. And see in the discourse of the Tefillin the reason why the time of Tefillin is by day and not by night. And there it will be well explained to you the matter of this discourse: how by day the Mochin do not depart completely, but remain on his head in the secret of encircling lights (Orot Makifin).
